questions.answer: BA

questions.answer: BA

questions.answer: The course i took where really difficult but they were very interesting

questions.answer: All of the course above except for project management.

questions.answer: very easy

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: Nothing they are very polite

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: How friendly everyone was.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: Make sure to find some good courses. Live off campus and look for Foco and other fun events through out the year.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Find some tough and some easy courses so there is a mix and you have time to explore instead of only doing school work.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: Completing all the courses, which had a ton of workload.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: Having to leave again it was so much fun!
